card.name: Ending of "in utero" and time words
card.fires_on: The word piece "ero" completing "in utero" in exposure statements. Also time-related words like "today" or "generations" after phrases about years or the future.

modes.label: in utero
modes.description: The ending "ero" of "in utero" before "exposure to" a drug.
modes.example: Closely observe infants with histories of in ut<<ero>> exposure to Lisinopril and Hydro

modes.label: Time words in general text
modes.description: Words such as "today" or "generations" that refer to a point in time or to future periods.
modes.example: they are passing the problem of adaptation on to future<< generations>>, when the price will be much higher

card.writes: Promoted tokens like 'ever', 'adays' and 'Seasons' hint at time-word endings, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of "in utero" and on some words about time, such as today or future generations.
